bio: If you’re planning a relaxing day out with a swim, this restaurant located between Valencia and the Parque Natural de La Albufera could be the perfect option for you. Part of the renowned Arrocería Maribel (El Palmar) restaurant group, it has the added bonus of a lounge and pool area where you can relax while enjoying a post-meal swim and drink. The traditional Valencian cuisine on offer features an impressive array of rice dishes (most of its paellas and creamy rice options need to be selected when you make your booking). The perfect setting for a family get-together!...
